body.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE very wide HORIZONTAL website in-article CTA design concept, aspect ratio EXACTLY 2:1 (1600x800 visual layout). Input reference is an approved Japanese product POP image: use only its identical teacher character and broad navy/white/yellow POP style. Replace ALL reference text. This banner will display at 672x336 on a desktop article; it must feel compact and horizontal, not a square poster stretched. Plain navy #16365c left panel occupying 65% and near-white right panel occupying 35%, a narrow yellow accent, no scenic/photo background. The left area has exact Japanese copy, large but orderly: small '技術士一次試験｜建設部門', dominant two-line '過去問PDF' then '全560問', subordinate single line 'A4印刷で、解いて復習', bottom green rounded button '教材の内容を見る'. Absolutely no other text, author claim, price, URL, logo, watermark. Strong white headline with modest yellow emphasis; secondary copy is smaller and calm, not every line oversized. In the right section, same teacher mascot, exact face/hair/glasses/beard, plain white helmet, blue work clothes, friendly half-body pointing to a stack of A4 papers with abstract gray lines only. Do not invent sample Japanese paper text. Reserve 5% margin on every edge. No overlapping headline/character. Flat UI-ish clean product CTA, less decorative than a marketplace thumbnail. No extra frame or screenshot of a browser. Reviewable composition concept; actual site will render Japanese text and CTA in HTML with separate existing mascot asset.

review.result: 原寸と文字部分の拡大で判読・文字の縁のにじみなし・構図不変を確認。375px のサイト表示は本番反映後に確認

edits.reason: ボタンの白文字と背景のコントラストを 4.5:1 以上にする（DN-0513。旧版は 2.22〜3.59:1）
edits.method: ボタン領域（x 65–933, y 664–824）の緑みの強い画素だけを緑の度合いに応じて最大 0.6 倍に暗くした決定的な補正。構図・人物・コピー・比率は不変
edits.contrast: ボタン画素の 95% が白文字に対し 4.96:1 以上（中央値 6.65:1）

tile.prompt: Edit this exact existing website sidebar banner. Change ONLY the green CTA button at the bottom: use a very dark, flat evergreen background #065F46 behind all white button letters, with no bright green gradient. Keep the exact button wording 「教材の内容を見る」 and white arrow. Preserve ALL OTHER existing text, character identity, helmet, paper, navy/white/yellow composition, pixel layout, proportions and 6:5 aspect ratio. This is a local contrast repair, not a redesign. No new text or objects. Button text must have at least 4.5:1 contrast against its entire background, including near edges of letters. Output the entire complete banner.

review.result: 原寸・幅300pxのサイト表示で、コピー一致・判読・文字切れなし・先生の同一性・濃緑ボタンの白文字を確認

previous.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one flat, finished-looking WEBSITE CTA DESIGN CONCEPT in LANDSCAPE 6:5 ratio (1200x1000 design canvas), for display at 300x250 in a desktop article sidebar. Use the supplied approved Japanese product POP image ONLY as visual style and character identity reference. Replace ALL original lettering, claims and subject. Exact new text: top small '建設部門'; main large two-line headline '技術士一次' and '過去問PDF'; small single benefit '全560問・A4印刷用'; bottom CTA pill '教材の内容を見る'. No other lettering. Navy #16365c color blocks, white background, white and yellow heavy Japanese typography with restrained outline; maximum clarity at 300px wide. Familiar identical teacher mascot on the right third: same face, black hair, black glasses, slight beard, plain white helmet, blue work clothes; waist-up, friendly pointing at a small stack of printed paper on the lower right. Left two-thirds contain headline. Only simple solid color panels, modest accent diagonal; no scenery, photo background, desk, complicated textures, tiny text, watermark, URL, prices, red sales explosion, or inherited civil construction wording. Avoid making everything loud: title is the only very large text, secondary copy calm, green CTA button at bottom. Keep all faces and text safely inside. This is a reviewable concept to later implement with separate HTML text and existing character assets.

review.result: 原寸・幅360px・サイト配置で判読、文字切れ、人物、縦横比を確認
